description: String of beads in decades with a crucifix, made to count the Catholic rosary prayers; five-decade, one-decade, finger, wrist and pocket rosaries are types, chaplets sold with them.
Loop of 108 (or 27, 54) beads with a guru bead and tassel, made to count mantra repetitions in Hindu and Buddhist practice; wrist malas are a short form.
String of 33, 99 or 101 beads with a divider and tassel, made to count Muslim dhikr; sold in wood, stone, seed and resin and as 33-bead bracelets.
Large candle blessed and lit at Easter, sold in beeswax or oil types with stands.
Small candle or glass-held light lit as a prayer or offering, in votive, vigil and 7-day devotional types.
Long-burning memorial candle in a glass, lit on the anniversary of a death and on festivals in Jewish practice.
Braided multi-wick candle lit at the close of the Sabbath, sold plain, decorated or with a spice box.
